authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: Full CDIAL *phāṭṭakka gate/door explicitly gives Punjabi, Nepali, Bihari and Hindi phāṭak gate, Assamese phaṭak gate and Gujarati phaṭkiyũ bārṇũ a single door shutter. Survey pʰaʈʌk door fits this gate/shutter family. Vowel length is retained as transcribed; Turner questions the deeper *prahaṭṭa derivation, which is not resolved here. Local IA transmission remains unresolved. Exact response: pʰaʈʌk.
